title: A Treatise on the Falling Iron Heaven
summary: A treatise on calling a mass of iron down from the sky, built from the hammer and plate lessons below it, ending in the iron cataclysm.

title: The Canon of Ten Thousand Unsheathed Blades
summary: A canon in which every edge of the cultivator's Core is drawn at once into a host of blades, ending in the blade apocalypse and the steel extinction.

title: The Divine Canon of Adamant Annihilation
summary: A canon of the divine realm in which the metal affinity is carried to its last edge, ending in the final anvil and the adamant annihilation.
